description: This PHP source file defines the ConfigurationProvider class within the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically for handling regional endpoint configurations for Amazon S3. It includes methods for creating configuration providers based on environment variables, configuration files, or default values, and supports composing multiple providers. The class implements methods to generate promises that resolve to configuration objects, along with utility functions to unwrap configurations from various formats.

classes.name: ConfigurationProvider
classes.description: Provides various configuration options for AWS S3 regional endpoints, supporting environment variable, config file, and fallback strategies, with support for composing multiple providers and caching.

methods.name: defaultProvider
methods.description: Creates a default configuration provider that checks environment variables, shared config files, and fallback defaults, with optional caching.

methods.name: env
methods.description: Creates a configuration provider that reads the regional endpoint setting from an environment variable.

methods.name: ini
methods.description: Creates a configuration provider that reads configuration from an INI file, with optional profile and filename.

methods.name: unwrap
methods.description: Converts various representations of configuration into a ConfigurationInterface object.
